Episode 34 expands the "Egyptian" plane / rental-car artifact chain and pivots into three investigative threads: (1) pre-assassination rooftop activity at UVU, including a CNN article and a September 11, 2025 audio recording of a UVU student describing a man on the Losee Center roof in the week before the shooting; (2) post-shooting security accountability, anchored by the Brian Harpole / Jeff Long text-exchange and the Brian Harpole interview with Shawn Ryan, plus Blake Neff's call-log screenshot timestamp; and (3) Rob McCoy's November 16, 2025 remarks in Jerusalem paired with the displayed Calvary Chapel magazine cover. Artifact-anchored claims advance the rental-vehicle identification chain (five plates), timestamp the rooftop sighting report, document the Harpole↔Long text exchange regarding rooftop access, and timestamp the post-shooting phone-call sequence. Framing premises about a "federal-level conspiracy" and characterizations of named individuals as dishonest are recorded but not inscribed as claims.

blocks.label: Harpole Says He Texted UVU Police Chief About Rooftop Access and Got "I Got You Covered"; Host Says He Did Not Follow Up

lines.v: In a clip the host plays, Brian Harpole, one of Charlie Kirk's long-term security team members, reads his texts to UVU Police Chief Jeff Long about student roof access near where Kirk would be set up, ending with the reply "I got you covered," and the host says Harpole did not follow up further.
Obtain the full text thread and timestamp metadata; confirm whether UVU PD logged any rooftop security assignment; check TPUSA advance-team documentation.

blocks.label: Blake Neff Says He Was Next to Mikey McCoy When the Shot Was Fired

Cross-reference video from TPUSA / event cameras and Stage area microphones; verify Neff's position with other contemporaneous witness accounts.

lines.v: Per a screenshot of Blake Neff's phone that the host shows, his call to his mother began at 11:24 and lasted 45 seconds; the host says that because Neff is now in Arizona this means 12:24 Utah time, and Mark says the time shown is when the call was initiated.
Independently confirm the phone metadata; obtain Neff's carrier records; map against Mikey McCoy's call to Erika and call to Rob McCoy.

lines: - **Claim failed admission test – C-uninscribed:** Host assertion that "a foreign military jet actually can't just land on American soil without the federal government paying attention" and "an escort is required" is sourced to an unnamed "high government source" with no documentary artifact. Not inscribed as a claim; retained as research target under N-10245. Artifact verbally referenced but not shown.
- **Name uncertainty:** "Tim P" appears verbatim in transcript; full name not expanded. Preserved as written.
- **Name uncertainty:** "Erika" / "Erica" Kirk – transcript inconsistently uses both spellings. Preserved as written in each instance.

- **Transcript ambiguity:** License plates as read aloud contain ambiguous letter/number substitutions (e.g., "T09 2Zs," "T9 1 2 KM"); plates as inscribed match the host's oral reading rather than a verified written source. Plate strings should be re-verified against rental records before downstream use.
- **Timestamp uncertainty:** Date of the Harpole↔Long text exchange is described as "on Monday before" but no date is given; the day-of-week reference is internal to the host's narration.

- **Possible transcription error:** Host admits mixing the letter N and the number 9 during prior episodes; some plates (e.g., A-1425.1 "CWN-N9872") may contain N/9 ambiguity by her own acknowledgement.
- **Requires human verification:** All A-1425.x plate strings require independent confirmation against rental records; A-1434.1 aircraft tail number not given.
